title: the subagents a user worker lists resolve through the same layers as every build: the project's plan wins over the user folder's plan and reaches claude as --agents
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). A worker's subagent names are resolved with the layered lookup from the launching project, so a user worker that lists plan gets the project's plan (its description, prompt, model and tools), not the user folder's plan.yaml, which the project's build shadows.
